title: 第1章 精神病骑士第2章 鲜花与猎犬
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第1章精神病骑士
姆莉封面图（看板娘？看书娘！）
“邪恶的巨龙啊！让你见识一下我与伙伴们深厚的羁绊之力吧！”一位骑士举着宝剑直指前方高大威猛的巨龙，随后突然转头看来。
“姆莉！快记下，击败这只巨龙，我一定就升级了！”
“好~好~”白发的绝美半妖精默默提笔书写眼前的一幕……也就是我，姆莉。
前面这个喊着羁绊啊、升级啊之类怪话的疯子骑士是我的老板——唐，而我呢，一个听信他鬼话被他拉上贼船的倒霉蛋吟游诗人。
我的工作就是记录他击败某不存在魔王的经历，然后改编成诗歌故事传扬出去。
“跟我一起高喊招式，声音越大气势越足技能威力就越强！伊艾克丝——咖喱棒！”
呵~我已经习惯了，从认识的第一天他就是个疯子。不过回想起来，距离我认识唐其实已经过去很久了……
那日正午，亚里罗王国边角一个名叫新约镇的小地方，街道与房屋整齐干净，但穷得使人悠闲，不少无事可做的居民就在老酒馆里醉生梦死。
劣质麦酒的酸味与烤肉的焦香弥散在空气中，暖黄的烛火在喧闹的碰杯声中摇曳，白发的半妖精吟游诗人低头用小竖琴弹出了彩色的音符，生涩而麻木的英雄故事被酒客们混着谣言八卦一同饮下。
“剧场那个姓唐的小子摔傻了！天天穿着纸壳子送花骚扰镇上的女人，自称什么正义骑士！”一个满脸横肉的大叔大声嚷嚷，“但别说，他还真有几分骑士老爷的本事，一棍就能撂倒窃贼！”
邻桌的男子压低了嗓子：“骑士、女人和窃贼？呵呵，最近镇上失踪的漂亮女人可不少，骑士团那帮废物连个屁都查不出来！我怀疑骑士团内部……”
另一桌人聊到一半突然一拍桌子：“听说了吗？有人在地下城的宝箱里开出了大量宝石！还有白白净净的大美人儿！”
刚刚结束演出的吟游诗人姆莉颓废地坐在吧台前向老板要水解渴，下意识抚过小竖琴的手定在空中不敢拨动琴弦，只是静静听着酒客们的交谈，脑子里都是对未来的迷茫。
唉，又白忙活一场，没有打赏也没有钱，只有醉鬼丢的一根鸡骨头。不带这么羞辱人的呀……
这不行那不会的，我这辈子也就这样了吧……
她耷拉着尖耳朵，从杯中的清水里尝到了酸涩。她不知道自己该做什么，也不知道自己想做什么，于是来新约镇找一个在花店的工作。
在此之前，她想最后再试一次，结果一如既往，于是现在放弃了继续当一位吟游诗人。
叹一口气，她将水钱和小竖琴留在了吧台上，然后机械地迈出酒馆，却在路过花坛的时候看到了一个奇怪的骑士。
那位男子穿着纸壳与铁皮拼凑而成的“铠甲”，腰间别着一根十字形的木棍，背后好似桌布的披风上写着大大的“正义”。
那男子单膝跪在地上，向一位相貌平平的民女举起了一枝红玫瑰，看样子是在告白……
等等，这家伙难道就是大家口中那位摔坏了脑子的剧场演员？想到酒客们的交谈，姆莉向唐投去了惊奇的目光，于是决定留步看看情况。
“哦！美丽的女士！自见到你的第一眼我便被你的美貌深深地打动，我已无法自拔地爱上了你，请你伸出高贵的右手接受我热烈的爱意！”
唐的语气与动作都很浮夸，就好像这是一场话剧演出，可他的眼里没有热情奔放的爱意，只有死水般的平静。
女子被这突然的告白弄得手足无措，连忙摆手拒绝道：“很抱歉，我已经有喜欢的人了。”
听到女子的拒绝，唐的脸上却没有一点失落的情绪，只是翻转着手中的玫瑰，将其变成了一朵带有祝福含义的蓝花。
第1章精神病骑士
姆莉认得那朵花，名为浓云抹，因香气浓郁得名，对气味有很强的覆盖性。它在吟游诗人的故事中一般是罪犯用来掩盖自身气味的道具，就连姆莉也常将它写入书中。
可是，他到底是怎么做到的？仿佛玫瑰凭空消失，再将浓云抹从其他地方变到手上一样。
难道是空间魔法？

Chapter 1 Psycho Knight
Cover picture of Muli (poster girl? Reading girl!)
"Evil dragon! Let me show you the power of the deep bond between me and my friends!" A knight raised his sword and pointed directly at the tall and mighty dragon in front of him, and then suddenly turned his head to look.
"Muli! Remember, if you defeat this dragon, I will definitely level up!"
"Okay~Okay~" The white-haired beautiful half-elf silently picked up a pen to write down the scene in front of her...that is, I, Muli.
The crazy knight in front of me shouting weird things like bonds and upgrades is my boss, Tang, and I am an unlucky bard who listened to his nonsense and was dragged into the pirate ship by him.
My job is to record his experience of defeating a non-existent demon king, and then adapt it into a poem and story to spread the word.
"Shou the moves with me. The louder and more powerful the voice, the more powerful the skills will be! Iax - curry stick!"
Ha~ I'm used to it. He has been a lunatic from the first day we met. But looking back, it has actually been a long time since I met Tang...
At noon that day, there was a small place called New Testament Town on the edge of the Kingdom of Ariro. The streets and houses were neat and clean, but it was so poor that people were leisurely. Many residents with nothing to do were drunk and dreaming in the old tavern.
The sour smell of inferior ale and the burnt aroma of barbecue filled the air. The warm yellow candlelight swayed amidst the noisy clinking of glasses. The white-haired half-elf bard lowered his head and played colorful notes on the small harp. The raw and numb heroic stories were mixed with rumors and gossip by the drinkers.
"That boy named Tang in the theater fell silly! He wears a paper shell and delivers flowers every day and harasses the women in the town. He calls himself a knight of justice!" A man with a sinister face yelled, "But don't tell me, he really has some skills as a knight. He can knock down thieves with one stick!"
The man at the next table lowered his voice: "Knights, women and thieves? Haha, there have been a lot of beautiful women missing in the town recently, and those losers in the Knights can't even find out! I suspect that within the Knights..."
In the middle of the conversation, someone at the other table suddenly slapped the table: "Have you heard? Someone found a lot of gems in the treasure chest in the dungeon! And there is a fair and beautiful woman!"
The bard Mli, who had just finished her performance, sat dejectedly in front of the bar and asked the boss for water to quench her thirst. She subconsciously touched the small harp with her hand fixed in the air and did not dare to pluck the strings. She just listened quietly to the conversations of the drinkers, her mind filled with confusion about the future.
Alas, it was all in vain again, no reward or money, just a chicken bone thrown by a drunkard. Don't be so humiliating...
If this doesn’t work, then it won’t. That’s how it will be for the rest of my life…
She drooped her pointed ears and tasted sourness in the clear water in the cup. She didn't know what she should do or what she wanted to do, so she came to New York to find a job in a flower shop.
Before that, she had tried one last time, with the same results, and now gave up on being a bard.
Sighing, she left the water money and the small harp on the bar, and then walked out of the tavern mechanically, but saw a strange knight when passing by the flower bed.
The man wore "armor" made of paper shells and iron sheets, with a cross-shaped wooden stick tied around his waist. The word "Justice" was written in large words on the cloak that looked like a tablecloth on his back.
The man knelt on one knee and raised a red rose to an ordinary-looking civilian girl. It seemed that he was confessing his love...
Wait, is this guy the theater actor who broke his brain as everyone said? Thinking of the conversation among the drinkers, Muli cast a surprised look at Tang, and decided to stay and see what was going on.
"Oh! Beautiful lady! I have been deeply moved by your beauty since the first time I saw you. I can't help but fall in love with you. Please extend your noble right hand to accept my warm love!"
Tang's tone and movements were very exaggerated, as if this was a drama performance, but there was no passionate love in his eyes, only stagnant calm.
The woman was at a loss by this sudden confession, and she quickly waved her hand and refused: "I'm sorry, I already have someone I like."
Upon hearing the woman's rejection, Tang didn't show any disappointment on his face. He just turned the rose in his hand and turned it into a blue flower with the meaning of blessing.
Chapter 1 Psycho Knight
Muli recognized the flower, which was called Nongyunmo. It was named because of its strong fragrance and its strong coverage of the smell. In bard stories, it is usually a prop used by criminals to mask their own scent, and even Muri often writes it in books.
But how did he do it? It was as if the rose disappeared out of thin air, and then the thick cloud moved from other places to the hand.
Could it be space magic?
